headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1/H2.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, labels, and standard text.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Rooted in Melayu Riau heritage)

primary.name: Hijau Lumut (Deep Moss Green)
primary.usage: Main branding, headers, active states, default buttons.

secondary.name: Merah Darah Burung (Deep Red)
secondary.usage: Destructive actions, alerts, booked seat status.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on hero sections to kill digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.

landing_page.details: Asymmetrical layout for marketing sections. Wide gaps (gap-8).

dashboards.details: Compact spacing (gap-4 or gap-6) for admin and travel loket dashboards.

component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn components. Never native <input>. Floating labels or clean top labels.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for landing page CTAs. Rounded-lg for dashboard buttons. ALWAYS set hover:text color explicitly.
component_guidelines.navigation: Glassmorphism header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Never fully transparent.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat background, 1px border (#E6E8EB), minimal shadow. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1).
component_guidelines.seat_map: Custom CSS grid representing a bus layout. Use colored squares: Hijau Lumut (available), Merah Darah Burung (booked), Kuning Keemasan (selected).

motion.hover: transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for search results using Framer Motion.
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Don't use transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses bg-black/40 overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-ticket-btn').

hero_background.description: Boats on a river representing regional tropical travel (Sumatra/Riau vibe). Use with a dark moss green gradient overlay.

transport_bus.description: White bus parked, representing inter-city bus travel.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use minimal framer-motion for smooth transitions. No heavy 3D required for booking dashboards, keep it fast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application starting with the landing page and search component.
Implement the UI in Indonesian as requested.
Use the exact font families requested (Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans).
Adhere to the Melayu Riau color palette (Moss Green, Golden Yellow, Deep Red) across the application. Avoid generic UI purples or standard blues.
Ensure the hero header is a glassmorphism header, not completely transparent.
When building dashboards, implement role-based views (Pengguna, Admin Loket, Manager/Kepala, Admin Aplikasi).
Use Shadcn UI extensively for inputs, tables, and dialogs.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and key interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
For icons, use lucide-react as the primary library.
